review.eventDescription: Charged when a review row is pushed. A review is pushed only when this charge, and the sentiment charge when that add-on is on, fits under maxSpendUsd. blocked, robots, not_found, spend_capped, and error rows are saved and not billed. $0.001 is the top of an unverified $0.0005–0.001 range. thewolves Store comps were not confirmed for this build.

sentiment.eventDescription: Charged once per pushed review when the sentiment input is true. Not charged for status rows, and not charged when sentiment is off.
